gaps: No crash effect at all for protected intersections, leading bike intervals, door-zone treatments, loading zones, vehicle exit warnings, bike-lane cameras, boarding islands or 3-foot enforcement; Dutch and Danish junction design guidance (CROW) was not opened, and swov.nl blocked the fetch.

Solo bike crashes are the biggest KSI source in this lane (447 hurt, 106 KSI of 400 bike KSI) and SF hospital data says police miss 69% to 82% of them; the only fixes with numbers are helmets (severity) and track separation. Surface repair has no measured effect.

Bicyclist-at-fault crashes carry most bike KSI (1,824 hurt, 259 KSI against 1,852 and 124 for drivers at fault). Few fixes in any source target rider red-light running (247 hurt, 42 KSI) or rider speed; the signal-timing effects are for motor traffic.

Scooter riders are mostly coded to the vehicles-only mode: 1,171 people hurt (153 KSI) had victim role Other, against 97 (4 KSI) in the vehicles-only bike-or-scooter-rules family. A scooter group by victim role is needed before scooter fixes can be sized.
Truck share of bike crashes is unknown (most trucks have no make-model weight), so side guards and direct vision can't be sized; 127 hurt (8 KSI) had a matched vehicle over 5,000 lb.

Costs missing for protected intersections, truncated tracks, protected left phases, signal retiming, bike-lane cameras, speed cameras per camera, loading zones and pricing. SFCTA and SFMTA per-treatment unit costs were not opened in this lane.
TØI's Norwegian handbook (tshandbok.no), Trafikverket's effect catalogue, SafetyCube, CROW and Austroads were not opened in this lane; the Danish handbook was the only Nordic source read in full.
Many targets use the at-fault movement only; the other party's movement (rider going straight) and signal presence are split across all bike families, not within each family.
Families with no fix mapped: bicycle involved | other (57 hurt, 5 KSI), DUI (8, 0) and phone use (1, 0); DUI fixes sit with the DUI lane.
The cross-cut group for high-stress signalized intersections is not a size_families row and should not be added to the family totals.
